title: Jada's Dare Grayt 30A Vacations
description_expanded: AboutJada’s Dare ~ 90 High Dune Drive ~ Grayton Beach FL 32459 Need a last-minute stay? Please call our office at 844-941-1213 to make last-minute bookings via telephone, as availability within the next 7-nights will not show on calendar. We do not allow online bookings within 7-nights/one week of an arrival date.Jada's Dare rents Weekly only (Sat-Sat only during Spring Break and Summer rate seasons) Jada’s Dare is a luxurious 3,476 sf home located in the private, Gulf Trace neighborhood with an additional 865 sq of outdoor living. With 5 bedrooms/5 full baths/1 half bath, Jada’s Dare will sleep up to 10 guests and offers a private heated saltwater pool (heating fee applies) and expansive views of the Gulf. Being surrounded by the Grayton Beach State Park gives guests ONE FULL MILE of beautiful, undisturbed beaches to enjoy; approximately 50 steps from private neighborhood beach access. PLEASE NOTE - Golf carts and on-street parking are STRICTLY PROHIBITED in the Gulf Trace neighborhood, per neighborhood covenants. Jada’s Dare borders the Grayton Beach State Park, named America’s #1 Beach in 2020 by Dr. Stephen Leatherman, aka Dr. Beach! “This beach boasts of its sugar-white sand and emerald green water where development has been restrained so big sand dunes still dominate the landscape. At the same time, all the amenities of great restaurants and accommodations are close by in the old town of Grayton Beach or Seaside," wrote Leatherman. Originally named the country’s top beach in 1994, Grayton Beach State Park has been listed FOUR times since 1991, finishing 6th in 2016 and 3rd in 2019. ** Need more room? Mimosa Mornings is located next door – these two homes rented together are perfect for multi-family vacations! ** *Please note - there are several large homes under construction on the beach in front of Jada's Dare and elsewhere in the neighborhood as of March 2024. Beach construction does obstruct views as shown in photos. Photos will be updated once construction along the beach has been completed. First Level: Living room. Dining table seats 8. Bar seating for 4. Kitchen. Wet Bar. Laundry room. 3 Bedrooms. 3 Full Bathrooms. Powder Room. Covered balconies. #1 En-suite Bedroom Room has a King bed, walk-in shower, double vanity, walk-in closet, partial Gulf view #2 En-Suite Bedroom has a King bed, tub/shower and Gulf view #3 En-Suite Bedroom has a King bed, walk-in shower and Gulf view Laundry Room has washer/dryer Second Level: 2 bedrooms. 2 baths. #4 En-Suite Bedroom has a Queen bed, walk-in shower and Gulf view #5 En-Suite Bedroom has a Queen bed, tub/shower and Gulf view Please note – no local channels on any Smart TV’s, streaming services available with guest account login. Amenities: Business Features Hi Speed Wireless Internet (password secured) Entertainment Features 6 Smart Tv’s (no local channels), board games, puzzles, books Distinctive Features Luxurious construction Expansive Gulf views Private heated saltwater pool (heating fee applies) Bed, bath, and kitchen linens provided Beach Gear Credit General Features Carport parking for 2 vehicles, driveway parking for 6 vehicles 3 King beds, 2 Queen beds 5 full bathrooms, 1 powder room, iron, ironing board, 5 hair dryers, outdoor foot wash, outdoor gas grill w/ grill utensils, outdoor porches, porch furniture. Linens provided. No Smoking. No Pets. *PLEASE NOTE - It is not recommended to heat the pool in colder weather, as heaters will not be able to heat to the desired setting as ambient temperatures fall below 50 degrees. Kitchen Features Fully equipped kitchen, Quartz countertops, KitchenAid stainless appliances, wine chiller, wet bar, separate ice maker, side-by-side refrigerator, electric oven, pantry, microwave, dishwasher, drip coffee maker, toaster, blender, washer, dryer. Area Features Timpoochee Trail (30A bike path) Seaside (2 miles) State Parks (Tops’l, Grayton Beach, Deer Lake)
